meta.name: hunt-nosqli
meta.description: Hunt NoSQL Injection — MongoDB operator injection ($where, $regex, $gt, $ne), CouchDB, Redis command injection, auth bypass via NoSQLi, data dump. Use when target uses MongoDB/Mongoose, CouchDB, Redis, or shows NoSQL error messages.

copy.tagline: 检测并利用 NoSQL 注入漏洞
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 MongoDB、CouchDB 或 Redis 上测试 NoSQL 注入漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Detect and exploit NoSQL injection vulnerabilities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to test NoSQL injection vulnerabilities on MongoDB, CouchDB, or Redis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你检测和利用 NoSQL 注入漏洞，包括 MongoDB 操作符注入、CouchDB 和 Redis 命令注入，以及绕过认证、提取数据等。
howto.when: 当目标使用 MongoDB、CouchDB、Redis 等 NoSQL 数据库，或返回 NoSQL 错误信息时触发。

say.text: 帮我测试这个登录接口是否存在 NoSQL 注入。
say.note: Claude 会尝试操作符注入绕过认证。

say.text: 用 $where 盲注提取用户数据。
say.note: Claude 会构造时间延迟注入并逐字符枚举。

say.text: 检查这个 URL 参数能否注入 NoSQL 操作符。
say.note: Claude 会测试数组语法和正则注入。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps detect and exploit NoSQL injection vulnerabilities, including MongoDB operator injection, CouchDB and Redis command injection, auth bypass, and data extraction.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the target uses MongoDB, CouchDB, Redis, or other NoSQL databases, or returns NoSQL error messages.

say_en.text: Test this login endpoint for NoSQL injection.
say_en.note: Claude will try operator injection to bypass auth.

say_en.text: Use $where blind injection to extract user data.
say_en.note: Claude will construct time-based delays and enumerate characters.

say_en.text: Check if this URL parameter is vulnerable to NoSQL operator injection.
say_en.note: Claude will test array syntax and regex injection.
